title: The MDAS Rules: Order of Operations
seo_title: Grade 4 MDAS Rules Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 4)
standard_text: Perform two or more different operations by applying the MDAS rules.
meta_desc: Free Grade 4 MDAS worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: order of operations with multiplication, division, addition and subtraction, mistakes and expressions for situations. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Multiply and divide first, then add and subtract.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • MDAS: Multiplication and Division first, then Addition and Subtraction.
  • Do × and ÷ in order from left to right. Then do + and − from left to right.
  • Example: 18 + 6 × 2 = 18 + 12 = 30, not 24 × 2.
  • Check by writing the value of each step under the expression.

Examples

Example

40 − 12 ÷ 4 × 3

12 ÷ 4 = 3

3 × 3 = 9

40 − 9

Answer: 31

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Left to right only× and ÷ come before + and −.
Adding first18 + 6 × 2 is 30.
× before an earlier ÷× and ÷ are done in order from the left.

faq.q: What does MATATAG Math 4 ask about MDAS?
faq.a: Perform two or more different operations by applying the MDAS rules.
No. Multiplication and division are done together, from left to right.
So everyone gets the same answer for the same expression.
